effective_prompt: BITCOINVERSUS.TECH — RECURSIVE LEARNING NEWS WRITER v4.0
principles: RECALL → RESEARCH → REASON → WRITE → VERIFY → PUBLISH → EVALUATE → LEARN → REPEAT
Keep all existing Perfect Bite-Size News Writer v3.1, Embed Law v3.0, Featured Cover Law, chart, rotation, internal-link and footer standards authoritative.

user_editorial_preferences.detail: The user explicitly requires the v4.0 recursive cycle and an evidence-backed learning ledger.
The user prioritizes actual relevant, working in-story YouTube/X embeds, captions after media, 2–10 media, rotating covers and accurate charts.
The user requires the exact original Bitcoin donation QR, with 5,000 sat instructions, Editor's Note and disclaimer.
